messages:
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK INITIATED -> env: canary | service: runtime-service | from: release-2.4.1 -> to: release-2.4.0 | reason: canary 5xx spike (~10%) detected by canary-checker. initiated_by: @vikram

vikram: kicked off rollback, watching canary metrics. pinned previous tag to prevent auto-rollforward.

lucy: ack — checking traces and recent deploy logs for regressions. will report any trace IDs.

ops-oncall: pausing traffic knob for canary, switching weight to baseline as rollback proceeds. tagging for oncall handoff.

release-mgr: quick Q — any DB migrations or config changes in 2.4.1? need to confirm release notes status.

vikram: no DB migrations, purely runtime + batching changes. release notes: small perf change + kv-cache tweak. tag details: release-2.4.1 (sha: c7b3f9e) -> release-2.4.0 (sha: a1d2f3b).

vikram: executed command:
```
./deploy rollback --service=runtime-service --env=canary --to-tag=release-2.4.0 --pin=true
```

deploy-bot: action: invoked k8s rollback (controlled).
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/runtime-service --to-revision=42
```

lucy: seeing version drift in canary pods come down to release-2.4.0, traces are stable so far. will post any failing spans.

ops-oncall: canary traffic weight back to baseline (0.0 -> 5% -> 0%). monitoring latency and error rate.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE -> env: canary | service: runtime-service | to: release-2.4.0 | duration: 3m12s | status: success. pins: service pinned to release-2.4.0 to prevent automatic promotion. logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/rollback/2190012345/logs

vikram: thanks. will open a follow-up PR to revert the problematic change and schedule a patched roll during the next change window.

release-mgr: next change window is 03:00 UTC. @vikram please prepare a short blurb for release notes and a rollback summary for the postmortem.

ops-oncall: created incident INC-2026-077 for tracking — link: https://incidents.example.com/INC-2026-077

lucy: adding a quick note to the traces ticket with affected spans and example request IDs.

deploy-bot: pinned routing policy: locked -> prevent canary promotion until manual unpin.

vikram: will follow up with root-cause writeup later today. thanks all. :thumbsup:
